title: Civ VI-directed visual quality

execution_policy.authorization: User handoff 2026-09-06: sole lead implementer and visual integrator owns all current Lab systems; previous exclusive ownership and cross-owner start blockers are superseded.
execution_policy.rule: Q0-Q8 remain requirement categories and historical namespaces. The sole lead may implement across their paths; do not restart former workers or delegate without user instruction.
execution_policy.shared_work: One coherent combined scene: render, inspect, fix the largest visible defect, rerender with matched inputs.
execution_policy.pending_evidence: Missing interfaces, test.biq acquisition, and final parity are tracked validation obligations. Use truthful local proxies or frozen inputs while continuing independent work; no fabricated acceptance.
execution_policy.promotion: LQ2 still requires accepted platform and visual results, real-map evidence, and combined D3D11 parity.

real_map_validation.required_for_acceptance: Every visual track must pass relevant verified test.biq regions plus a neighboring or held-out region, with source/region/layer provenance and synthetic evidence for documented coverage gaps.
real_map_validation.historical_source_warning: PREPARE_L13_BIQ_VIEWPORT.bat reads Intro1 Ancient Treasures.biq; its test_biq_l13_rivers_192.csv output name is not test.biq provenance.

promotion_rule: LQ2 requires every non-platform track accepted with the real-map validation policy satisfied, one combined Metal promotion matrix, bounded D3D11 parity, deterministic repeats, and a versioned v2 handoff set.
